items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Dizzy said this in his act... he was allegedly an authority on jazz

ctx.x: Now, that's -- Dizzy said this in his act, and it was so appropos. You know, (he said) you know his name wasn't Paul Blackman. But any way it was in the Saturday Evening Post, it was like a jazz poll and he was allegedly an authority on jazz, you know. But any way --
